author: ezpz-content
instruction_bn: বন্ধনীর verb-এর সঠিক রূপ বসাও (Board: right form of verbs, 0.5×14)।

items.q: He ___ his breakfast every day at 8 am. (take)
I have been reading the book ___ two hours. (for/since)
Had I been a bird, I ___ have flown. (would)
items.rule_bn: Third conditional (past unreal): would have + past participle।

items.q: The teacher made the boy ___ the poem. (recite)
items.rule_bn: 'make + object'-এর পরে base verb বসে: recite।

items.q: It is time you ___ the truth. (know)
items.rule_bn: 'It is time'-এর পরে past form: knew।

items.q: The sun having ___, we started for home. (set)
Neither of the boys ___ done the work. (have)

items.rule_bn: 'Many a + singular noun'-এর সাথে singular verb: has।

items.q: The quality of the mangoes ___ not good. (be)
